title: Critique: no group of subjects entails a further subject

statements.text: No Summing of Subjects: the existence of any number of subjects with any phenomenal characters never a priori entails the existence of another subject. Spatial parts entail the whole they compose, subjects do not, so no group of microsubjects necessitates a macrosubject.

sources.quote: It is never the case that the existence of a number (one or more) of subjects of experience with certain phenomenal characters a priori entails the existence of some other subject of experience.
If so, then no group of microsubjects necessitates the existence of a macrosubject.
